status: Conservative semantic grouping; pre-split review artifact, not dataset splits
selection_rule: Earliest timestamp, then trace ID among human-approved eligible cases; never select by label. Original human judgments remain unchanged.
limitations: Rules merge public-policy paraphrases across user IDs and roles because the requested policy facts do not depend on caller identity.
Public store-name/category queries merge by requested store; public product queries merge by product/store/budget.
Private order cases retain customer/authorization and order context. Distinct order records remain separate even when the failure mechanism repeats.
This is a conservative rule-based close-variant audit, not a proof of statistical independence.
